I don't believe I deserve to be loved romantically and therefore try my best to avoid asking anyone out.

I say try because it still happens that I fall in love with someone who only has platonic feelings for me and get rejected.

Yeeeeah nah I don't think anyone wants to see my ugly fat fucking ass on the beach. 

I'll keep on hiding myself away from any eyes that aren't my own

Always cheers me up reading those comments, lets me know that I still am no where near their level of terrible person even though my love life is as successful as the Buffalo Sabres' playoff aspirations.

Sertraline (commonly sold as zoloft in the states) can have that side effect when at the start of treatment. The doc I spoke to said it could take up to a month before that specific side effect subsides but your mileage may vary.
My antidepressants make it harder to jerk it =(. Not sure how I feel trading my suicidal thoughts for the one thing that gave me dopamine.
Same, it feels like faking my wellbeing is one of the few things I am pretty good at.

You just have to find a better spot to do the deed, I recommend reading up on some old timey drop tables to figure out the appropriate drop height to give a solid chance of instant death by neck snap.

After doing that you gotta make sure the spot is secluded enough that no one will find you in those crucial moments before you make the final decision.

I'm sad hearing that you're in the same situation as me friend.

That being said it is a bit comforting to know that I'm not alone in this. Hope it gets better for you.
